content: Ceftibuten should be administered according to the recommended doses provided for CEDAX Oral Suspension. For pediatric patients who weigh more than 45 kilograms, the maximum daily dose should not exceed 400 milligrams. In patients with renal impairment, both CEDAX Capsules and CEDAX Oral Suspension can be administered at standard doses if the patient’s creatinine clearance is 50 mL/min or greater. Specific dosing recommendations for patients with varying levels of renal insufficiency are outlined in a separate table. For patients undergoing hemodialysis two or three times per week, a single 400-milligram dose of ceftibuten capsules or a single dose of 9 milligrams per kilogram of the oral suspension (up to a maximum of 400 milligrams) should be administered at the conclusion of each hemodialysis session. When preparing CEDAX Oral Suspension, the suspension must be stored in the refrigerator after mixing and can be used for up to 14 days. The bottle should be kept tightly closed, and the suspension must be shaken well before each use. Any remaining suspension should be discarded after 14 days.
